'''Alkin Saad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] training within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Alkin Saad was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] experimental [[Almas Academy|Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Selected as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tantron Dow]], the pair were sent on a mission to investigate the disappearance of several Jedi in the [[Almas Wasteland]]s in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. During their search, the [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] Saad was piloting was shot down by a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] operated by members of the [[Believers]] cult, killing Saad and injuring Dow.<ref name="DC" />
